integrations.scandrix-docs-default: ScanDrix Docs MCP exposes the official ScanDrix documentation as MCP tools, allowing ScanDrix AI to respond with official snippets, setup guides, and best practices always up to date.
integrations.scandrix-issues-default: Read issues from your repository's tracker (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, or Forgejo) using your existing ScanDrix code-management integration—so reviews can be cross-referenced against the issue they implement.
integrations.sentry-default: Sentry MCP allows agents to access project and team info, retrieve and update issues and events, and create releases—bringing production error tracking into your automated code reviews.
integrations.exa-default: Exa Search MCP allows agents to perform web and codebase intelligence searches to retrieve relevant documentation and patterns.
integrations.scandrix-osv-default: ScanDrix OSV MCP allows agents to query the Open Source Vulnerability database for known security CVEs and package advisories in your codebase.
integrations.linear-default: Create and manage Linear issues: create, update, and label tasks, add comments, fetch cycles, projects, and states—keeping code reviews and your sprint backlog synchronized.
integrations.atlassian-rovo-default: Atlassian Rovo MCP enables agents to search across your Atlassian ecosystem (Jira, Confluence) and retrieve relevant knowledge and context.
integrations.notion-default: Notion MCP lets agents read and search your Notion workspaces, databases, and engineering specs—bringing product requirements directly into code reviews.
integrations.fireflies-default: Fireflies MCP exposes meeting transcripts, summaries, and action items so agents can ground pull request decisions in what was architecturally discussed.
